I'll combine the structural idea of the current program (greedy builder + local search with re-color/swap/remove moves) with the refinement machinery from inspiration 1 (recolor-then-add pass that tests whether a recoloring unlocks new edges, plus a tighter time budget).

3. **Tighter deadline** (145s) to leave safety margin.
4. **More aggressive local search** with the recolor-unlock move weighted higher.
